comments.body:
English Guide

1).Speak to the Aristocrat girl standing in front of the church in Genoa.
2).Speak to Local Women to the left of the church in Genoa.
3).Speak to the Scholar in Alexandria.
4).Speak to the Rest House Master in Alexandria.
5).Speak to the Customer to the left in Alexandria.
6).Speak to the same Customer again.
